_comment: Tracked inputs of tools/extract/extract_gate_sounds.py (docs/progress/gate-sounds.md). clips: per Arena gate clip (by its AudioClip name) how the client may shorten it to the port's door timing and whether the extractor bakes the authored pitch. mode body_cut = the client may remove ONE stationary stretch of the clip between body[0] and body[1] seconds (equal-power crossfade, head, impact and tail untouched) so that the end event (the thunk or bang that marks the end of the motion, event_s seconds into the clip) lands about when the shortened motion ends; mode as_is = never cut (an impulse-like or very short clip). event_s and body are analysis numbers measured on the decoded clips (envelope and transient scan, 2026-10-25), not Arena data. bake_pitch = the clip is resampled by this factor when it is extracted (AirPit's passport and bus-door players play their clip at pitch 1.25 / 1.2): the shipped bytes are then no copy of the clip, which for the passport clip lives in sharedassets28.resource, a stage-2 key-source file of arena_airpit (docs/PLAN-ENCRYPTION.md section 6). borrowed_rows: sound rows for gates that Arena authors a motion for in the port but no emitter: the row copies its lender's sound and puts the emitter at the same offset from the door origin.
